context.body: A later reformer compresses love, election, greatness, and failure into one warning.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Nehemiah confronts Judeans over foreign marriages and cites Solomon as a beloved king led into sin by foreign women.
observations.label: Nehemiah uses Solomon as a warning: action

observations.body: Postexilic family and language practices are judged through remembered royal failure.
observations.label: Nehemiah uses Solomon as a warning: response

observations.body: Solomon king of Israel · loved by his God · foreign women caused him to sin
observations.label: Words in Nehemiah 13:23–27

payload.posture: Read Nehemiah 13:23–27 as later memory and aftermath evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The application addresses Nehemiah’s crisis and does not erase the complexity of every cross-cultural marriage in Scripture.
